title: The Penitent Magdalen
artist: Georges de La Tour (French, Vic-sur-Seille 1593-1652 Lunéville)
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Charles Wrightsman, 1978 (accession 1978.517, object 436839)
notes: Cropped to the painted canvas and scaled to 1800 px wide. magdalen-unlit.webp is a patch with both painted flames removed (masked and filled from the neighbouring mirror glass); magdalen-light.webp is a derived light-influence map; magdalen-grain.webp is a high-pass of the canvas texture round the mirror; magdalen.json is the rig (flame positions, mirror clip). Prepared offline with Python/Pillow.
